title: Operations & Project Manager (Fast Growing)
description:
Operations Manager-Execution Partner-Project Killer-Fast-Growing Comic Book Company



Own the operations backbone of a niche comic book brand, work directly with leadership, and get promoted fairly by numbers.



This role is for that special person who wants to become truly exceptional. If that’s you, you already know this message is your signal.



What You Get If You Win Here

- High autonomy: once you’re ramped, you own your queue, schedule, and methods as long as the KPIs are hit. Lots of freedom to figure it out, great for someone that loves building with Legos

- Direct proximity to leadership: you work daily with the Ops Manager on the most important projects in the company.

- Clear advancement path: your growth is tied to visible numbers (tasks shipped, zero-miss cadence, freed founder/ops time, profit/leading metrics), not politics.

- Insane skill growth: the pace and standards here mean every 12 months with us will feel like 3 years of experience in a normal VA/ops role. You can leapfrog your friends. If you join this will change your life. You will work harder than you’ve ever worked before and grow faster than you’ve ever grown before.

- Comic Books!: you’re not just pushing random SaaS tickets; you’re inside a real comic book store seeing rare old comic books, private deals, and the business behind the Hollywood Marvel Movies that everyone loves!

If you’re that person who enjoys working really hard to the point that it takes 2-3 people to do what you did listen up:

Our tasks in asana for projects and ongoing operations are moving at a snail’s pace.

Ops Manager + CEO is chasing tasks, slack policing, cleaning up Asana, and re-explaining context instead of focusing on their jobs.



We’ve had “pleasant” VAs who:

Can’t drive tasks to completion independently

Mark tasks complete with no proof

Miss reports/skip cadence and require chasing.

Drift on ownership, urgency & follow thru

Need hand-holding

I don’t need another task hopper. I need a project killer who comes into ambiguity, creates structure, drives tasks to completion, and actually frees the Ops Manager to focus on his key projects. If this works, his deep work hours and project output go up because you’re handling everything else. We will measure that and tie your promotions/raises to it. This is not for everyone. We’re looking for winners.



What You’ll Actually Do

You will be Ops Manager’s execution partner and force-multiplier. Concrete outputs:

Own Asana: every task has an owner, due date, Done Check, and proof link when completed

Maintain an active queue of 20+ meaningful tasks, prioritized against our key rocks (Marketing, Sales, Ongoing Operations, Cleanup, Admin)

Ship 25+ tasks/week with proof, minimal rework, and zero “ghosted” items

Proactively handle operational issues/fires in designated lanes

Maintain Reporting at Set Cadence, Follow-up loops across projects

Add leverage: plug AI into our workflows (Asana, docs, reports) to make us faster and cleaner without being asked

We do NOT need more SOPS-although you might tighten them on the fly. We need someone to do the operations. If you want to sit and write playbooks all day, this is the wrong seat-that will be an earned responsibility later. If you aren’t ready to work hard daily do not apply.



How We Set You Up To Win (First 90 Days)

We don’t just throw you in the deep end. In your first 30 days, you’ll shadow the Ops Manager, learn our Asana + reporting systems, and get a clear scorecard so you always know what “great” looks like. By 30 days, you’ll own your own project lanes with weekly 1:1s for feedback, support, and removing blockers so you can move faster instead of guessing what we want.



Real Growth Example

One of our Filipino teammates started with us on basic execution work at ~$800/month. Over time, he took ownership of his queue, fixed broken processes, and became the person we trusted to “just handle it.” As his scope grew, so did his comp and stability. Now he makes ~$2,500/month (and we’re working on getting him even more) because he stuck with it and actually grew. A lot of people say they want that, but their resumes show 6–12 month hops. The pattern here is simple: prove you can own outcomes over time, and we grow your responsibilities, trust, and pay accordingly.



Schedule, Hours & Time Zone (No Surprises)

This is a full time, US hours role (roughly US Eastern business hours) with a true 50–60 hour workweek during this growth season. Expect most weeks to be closer to that 60 hour mark. If you want a strict 40 hour cap, this is the wrong seat; if you want a place where extra effort is noticed, measured, and rewarded, you’ll feel at home here. This is not just a job. This is a commitment.



What Winning Looks Like

By Day 30: Ops Manager is spending ~95% of his time on projects, not Slack/Asana/admin fires, because you’re handling those and executing projects alongside him. Profit and leading metrics are moving up faster because of you



By 12 months: You are Ops Manager’s go to operator & on track to become Ops Manager. Nothing important moves in Ops without you knowing. You own the Asana board, key ops projects, and reporting cadence. You’re the person we trust to “just handle it,” and your comp reflects that increased ownership.



If you become that go to operator, you’ll have real say in how we run Ops – you won’t just be ‘executing tickets,’ you’ll help design the system.”



Who This Is NOT For

You prefer to ‘coordinate’ and assign tasks to others instead of doing the work yourself with excellence.

You want to manage people before you’ve truly proven you can personally execute at a high level.

You want a chill, low-pressure 9–5

You need to be told what to do all day and hate being judged by objective numbers

You mark tasks complete without proof or next steps

You change jobs every 6–18 months and blame the company/manager/market/

You get defensive or freeze when given direct feedback or pressure

You are currently juggling multiple full time clients and want to “squeeze us in” on the side.

You are mass applying to dozens of jobs and just want to see who bites first.





Who This IS For

You’ve stayed 2–3+ years in at least one role and can prove outcomes

You like pressure, highly competitive environments, being the one who “gets it done” when others stall

You’ve built systems (trackers, automations, SOPs), not just followed them

You are tech-comfortable: Asana (or similar), CRMs, zaps, AI tools, simple web/ops/marketing stacks

You’re willing to bet on one company instead of juggling lots of smaller, easier gigs.

You hate corporate BS– endless meetings, vague goals, and politics – and would rather be rewarded for what you actually create.

You’re happy to grind 50–60 hours/week no issues. We’re in a BIG growth & push season. It will be like this for the next year and then we’ll see. Everyone wants to grow a lot, but it’s actually happening here.



Comp & Growth

(All of this is written into your contract.)

Months 1–3: Ramp / Trial

• $800/month base, guaranteed, while you learn our systems and we test fit.

• No bonus in this phase. You’re paid to prove you can hit the KPI floors.

Month 4+ – Performance Based Upside

• Base stays at $800 until you’ve hit KPI floors for 2 straight months. After that, base increases to $900/month going forward.

• On top of base, you can earn:

$400 bonus in months where you hit 3 out of 4 KPIs (with Output as one of them).

$1,000 bonus in months where you hit 4 out of 4 KPIs on the weekly scorecard.

• In practice, that means:

Solid performance months ~$1,200–$1,300/month

Killer months (4/4 KPIs)~$1,800–$1,900/month

All bonuses are 100% KPI based (shipped outcomes, taking load off the Ops Manager, zero CEO/manager rescues, tight open loops) and 4/5 culture.



Training & Growth Investment (on top of pay)

We actively invest in making you a sharper teammate. Over time, we’ll put thousands of dollars into your development (courses, coaching, playbooks, and tools) that we choose together based on what will make you more effective in this seat.

We also protect uninterrupted deep work blocks for you every week (no random meetings, no Slack spam). You’re paid to ship outcomes, not sit in back to back Zoom calls.



Important: This is an ON FIELD role. You will not have a team under you to delegate to.

95% of your time is doing the work yourself, 5% is light coordination. If your default mode is to make plans and pass tasks to others, this will be a bad fit.



Compensation here is performance based. Raises are earned through clearly exceeding KPIs and demonstrating core values consistently. If you want “stability” to mean “I can coast and still get raises,” this won’t feel stable. If you want stability to mean “the better I get, the more valuable and secure I become,” you’ll like it here.



How To Apply (24-Hour Test) Our Hiring Process (So There Are No Surprises)



If your 24 hour answers impress us, the next steps are:

A short interview focused on your past execution.

A live 60 minute work trial inside our real tools where you’ll work directly with the Ops Manager. We do this because talk is cheap. If you don’t like being tested on real work before getting hired, this won’t be a fit.



Do NOT click quick-apply. In the next 24 hours, you must:



Reply with answers to ALL of these (short but specific; bullets are fine):

Q1: Describe the most complex project you personally drove from messy start to completion where you did most of the execution yourself, not just assigning tasks. Include at least one example of how you set your own deadlines and moved forward when other people were slow to respond.”

Q2: Share 3 links or screenshots (Google Docs, Sheets, Asana boards, trackers, automations, etc.) that you built yourself which show how you organize and drive work. Briefly explain each.

Q3: You have 30 tasks due this week and realize you’ll miss 5. Walk me through, step-by-step, how you handle it with your manager and stakeholders.

Q4: Below are 6 messy “tasks” we actually see (all dumped into one list):

– “Fix Asana, it’s a mess”

– “Seller lead texting follow up??”

– “Finance com/projections cadence d2 ”

– “Inventory backlog insane”

– “Need better reporting”

– “Update SOPs

In this role you will NOT have anyone to delegate to assume it’s just you and the Ops Manager.

In a Google Doc, please:



Rewrite these into clear tasks with: Owner (you or Ops Manager), Due Date (next 7–30 days), and a concrete Done Check + proof required. “Write your task descriptions as if you are committing: ‘I will do X by Y time. If Z doesn’t happen by [time], here’s my fallback.’ Generic ‘follow up / request access’ answers will fail you.”

Put them in the order you’d actually do them and explain why in 3–5 bullet points.



Link the Google Doc here (view access).



Spend no more than 30–45 minutes. If you can’t figure this out on your own, this role will be too hard in real life – that’s okay, just skip applying.



Attach your PDF resume/Google Drive link.

title: Cold Email Outreach Operator, Part-Time (Instantly) for a US Amazon Agency
description:
PART-TIME: about 5 hours a day, Monday to Friday. Please only apply if part-time works for you.



We are an Amazon advertising and brand-growth agency. We run the Amazon channel for about 25 US consumer brands. Cold
 is the outbound channel that brings us signed clients, and we need one operator to run it.



The system already exists. Instantly is running on a multi-domain setup, our list tools are in place, and GoHighLevel is our CRM. You do not build this from scratch. You run it well and close the gaps.



The first gap: a positive reply today writes a tag on a contact and nothing else happens. No deal, no task, no alert. That is your first fix.



WHAT YOU RUN



- Lists. US consumer brands and manufacturers that sell physical products. Pull, clean and verify every list, and remove current clients, before anything sends.

- Instantly. Campaigns, inbox rotation, warmup and deliverability: bounces, blacklists, spam placement. You catch a problem before it costs us a domain.

- Copy. Sequences go out under the founder's name and in his voice. You write and test them. The founder approves.

- Replies. Every reply sorted within one business day: positive to the founder the same day, "not now" to a dated follow-up, wrong person to a referral ask, unsubscribes honored.

- GoHighLevel. A positive reply becomes a deal, a task and an alert, not a bare tag.

- Reporting. Every Monday, per campaign:
s sent, contacts reached, replies, positive replies, meetings booked, meetings held.



WHAT WE MEASURE



Qualified meetings: the right company, a person who can d
, who shows up. Positive replies routed the same day. Domains that stay out of spam.



WHAT YOU NEED



- Two or more years running B2B cold
 yourself: list, copy, sending and replies.

- Instantly at the level of diagnosing a deliverability drop. Smartlead or lemlist experience counts if you can show it.

- Real numbers from a campaign you ran: sends, replies, positive replies, meetings booked.

- Written English good enough that your
s go out without rewriting.

- At least 4 hours of overlap with US Pacific business hours, every weekday.

- Daily use of AI (Claude, ChatGPT or Clay's AI) for list research and personalization, and the judgment to catch it when it gets a company or a name wrong.

- GoHighLevel and Clay or Apollo are a plus. Amazon knowledge is not required.



This is one person's seat. We are not hiring an agency.



HOW TO APPLY



Put the phrase LIST BEFORE VOLUME at the top of your application. Use this exact phrase for this role only. We do not read applications without it.



Then send:

1. Your resume or LinkedIn.

2. One cold
 campaign you ran yourself: who it targeted, the numbers (sent, replies, positive replies, meetings booked, meetings held), and what you changed when it underperformed.

3. The hours you can work each weekday, in US Pacific time.

4. Your monthly rate in USD for about 25 hours a week, and what other work you have right now.



HOW WE HIRE



1. Application. We reply to every complete application within 5 business days, yes or no.

2. Three quick questions, including a short screen recording of a live campaign.

3. A short written exercise.

4. Video call with the founder.

5. Paid trial on our real stack, then a long-term contract with room to grow the hours.



We are an equal opportunity employer. We d
 on the work you show us.

Send a brief description of your experience with Google Flow and CapCut, along with **2–3 examples of AI videos you’ve created and edited**. Explain which parts of each video you handled yourself.

title: Virtual Assistant — Inbound Sales & Customer Service
description:
Rebel Meat Co | Australian Meat Delivery Business



Rebel Meat Co is a growing Australian meat delivery business seeking an experienced inbound sales VA to turn online enquiries into paid orders and build lasting customer relationships.



You’ll manage conversations primarily through
 Messenger—from the first enquiry through to product selection, invoicing and follow-up.



The role



* Understand customers’ needs, recommend suitable products and confidently guide enquiries through to paid orders.

* Clearly explain products, wholesale carton sizes, variable weights, pricing and delivery.

* Follow up leads and unpaid invoices without being pushy.

* Prepare accurate invoices and maintain customer and order records.

* Build rapport online and deliver excellent customer service.

* Take ownership of enquiries, anticipate questions and follow through, escalating issues when needed.



What we’re looking for



* Proven inbound sales experience, including handling enquiries, following up leads and closing sales, ideally through written chat.

* A strong understanding of the sales process and how to address customer questions and objections.

* Excellent written English and comprehension—you can understand informal Australian messages, pick up nuance and respond naturally.

* Good judgement and the ability to handle varied enquiries without relying entirely on scripts.

* A customer-focused, sales-driven approach and a willingness to go above and beyond.

* Accuracy and attention to detail when handling prices, orders and invoices.

* Reliable internet and place to work from home



Previous experience serving Australian customers is strongly preferred.



What we offer



USD $4-5 per hour, paid weekly.



* A supportive environment, with training on our systems and processes.

* An opportunity to grow with the business and take on greater responsibility.

* Flexibility around an agreed working schedule, with give and take on both sides during busy periods.

* Approximately 2–4 hours of work across the weekend, paid at your hourly rate, with timing agreed in advance.



To apply



Please describe your inbound sales experience, the channels you’ve sold through, your experience with Australian customers and any invoicing systems you’ve used. Include your availability for weekday and weekend work.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a practical assessment involving customer enquiries and a simple invoicing task.



How to apply



Please answer these questions in your application:



Describe your most recent inbound sales role. What did you sell, through which channels, and were you personally responsible for closing sales?



Have you served Australian customers? If so, describe your experience.



Which invoicing systems have you used?



Confirm your availability, including 2–4 paid hours across the weekend, and acceptance of USD $4–$5 per hour, paid weekly.



Write the reply you would send to this customer:



“I’m interested in your scotch fillet, but a whole carton is a lot of money. Can I buy a smaller amount? How does delivery work?”



For this exercise, assume we sell whole cartons only and offer free delivery throughout Melbourne. Your reply should answer their questions and move the conversation towards an order.



Applications must answer all five questions to be considered.



(Any applicants contacting us directly will be immediately disqualified)

 and SMS as needed.

3. Accounts Payable

- Maintain accurate payable records.

- Supplier payment execution is handled by the business owner.



4. Monthly Bookkeeping and BAS Preparation

- Complete monthly reconciliations and GST coding reviews.

- Ensure accounts are accurate and BAS-ready by the 5th business day of each month.

- Provide concise monthly financial and outstanding receivables summaries.



Payroll processing and payroll reconciliation are excluded from this contract.



Typical Monthly Workload



Please base your fixed monthly quotation on the following anticipated workload:



| Activity | Typical Monthly Volume |

|---|---|

| Sales invoices (automatically generated and sent) | 600 |

| Supplier bills | 50 |

| Bank transactions (3 accounts) | 400 |

| Xero transaction line items | 1200 |

| Active chart-of-accounts categories | up to 60 |

| Accounts receivable follow-ups | Ongoing |



Invoices are automatically generated through Halaxy, so manual invoice creation is not required.



There is no historical bookkeeping backlog, inventory management or multi-currency processing.



Required Skills and Qualifications



- Proven experience using Xero for Australian business bookkeeping.

- Sound understanding of Australian GST and BAS preparation requirements.

- Relevant accounting or bookkeeping qualifications, preferably Xero certification.

- Experience managing accounts receivable, accounts payable and reconciliations.

- Strong attention to detail, accuracy and organisational skills.

- Excellent written English and professional communication skills.

- Ability to manage deadlines independently.

- Commitment to confidentiality, data security and professional accountability.



Highly Regarded

- Experience supporting Australian healthcare, allied health or medical businesses.

- Familiarity with Halaxy or similar practice management systems.

- Registered bookkeeping business or established team with dedicated staff and backup arrangements.

- Proven long-term client relationships and references.



Contract Details



- Location: Remote

- Engagement: Independent contractor, fixed monthly fee.

- Budget: Below AUD $200 per month, all-inclusive.

- Working hours: Flexible.

- Communication: Primarily
, phone, message.

- Initial arrangement: Paid trial period followed by an ongoing contract, subject to satisfactory performance.

- Monthly deadline: All bookkeeping completed to BAS-ready standard by the 5th business day.



We are seeking competitive quotations that offer excellent value for money without compromising quality, accuracy or reliability.



How to Apply



Please submit the following information:



1. Fixed Monthly Quote: Your most competitive all-inclusive monthly fee in AUD or PHP, based on the typical workload outlined above.

2. Credentials: Relevant qualifications, Xero certifications and business registration details (if applicable).

3. Experience: Brief examples of similar Australian businesses you currently support or have supported.

4. Team Structure: Whether you are a registered company, established team or individual contractor, including backup arrangements.

5. Work Process: How you manage monthly reconciliations, overdue accounts and deadlines.

6. Availability: Your proposed trial period and earliest commencement date.

7. References: Relevant client references, where available.



#Mandatory 100-Word Application Statement



In 100 words or fewer, answer the following question:



"Why is your team the best fit to win this bookkeeping contract?"



Demonstrate what sets you apart, including your qualifications, relevant Australian bookkeeping experience, reliability, ability to manage the workload and the value your services offer.

Selection Process:

title: AI Operations Manager (Amazon Agency, ClickUp + Make + AI)
description:
We are an Amazon advertising and brand-growth agency. We run the Amazon channel for about 25 consumer brands: ads, listings, creative, catalog, inventory and strategy. The team is small and fully remote, and you report to the two founders with nobody in between.



THE JOB



More and more of our work runs on AI agents and automations: client reports, listing drafts, ad recommendations, outbound
, social posts, lead routing. The founders build most of the agents. You make sure they work.



Every day you check that each agent and automation produced what it should. You catch the ones that ran but produced the wrong thing, which is the failure that matters most. You fix what you can, escalate what you can't, and keep human approvals moving so nothing wrong reaches a client. You also own ClickUp and the automations around it, and you overhaul how we run client delivery and our own sales and marketing.



WHAT YOU RUN AND OWN



- The agent registry: every agent and automation we run, what it should produce, and how to tell it worked.

- A daily health check on outputs, not run logs. "It ran with zero errors" is not proof it worked.

- Quality control on AI work: you check reports, listings and
s against the source before a client sees them.

- The approval queue: agents draft, people approve. You keep it moving and prepare decisions for the founders.

- I
 and runbooks: when something breaks, contain it, fix or escalate it, then write down how to catch it next time.

- ClickUp as the single source of truth for client delivery and internal work.

- Make automations: you repair them, monitor them, and build the small ones.

- A weekly operations report the founders can read in five minutes.



WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE



Day 30: you know every agent and automation we run and how to tell each one worked. A daily health check is running.

Day 60: AI errors are caught before a client sees them, and every i
 has a runbook.

Day 90: the founders stop asking "did anyone check this?"



WHAT YOU NEED



- You have overseen AI output in a real business, not only in a course: you checked it, caught it being wrong, and fixed the process.

- Daily hands-on use of Claude or ChatGPT to produce work, and the judgment to tell when an AI output is wrong even though it looks finished.

- ClickUp at administrator depth: spaces, custom fields, automations, dashboards. You will show this on a screen recording.

- Make at working depth: you can open a scenario, read its history and work out why it stopped or why it produced bad data. n8n or Zapier also counts.

- Operations experience at an agency or service business, beyond a coordinator role.

- Clear written English. You can explain a problem to a founder in five lines.



Not required: Amazon knowledge or advertising experience.



Hours: flexible, with at least 4 hours of overlap with US Pacific business hours each weekday.



Tools: ClickUp, Make, Claude, ChatGPT, GoHighLevel, Instantly, Missive, Google Workspace, Slack, Fireflies.



HOW TO APPLY



Put the phrase CHECK THE OUTPUT at the top of your application. Use this exact phrase for this role only. We do not read applications without it.



Then send:

1. Your resume or LinkedIn.

2. A time an AI tool or automation produced something that looked finished but was wrong. What was it, how did you catch it, and what did you change so it would be caught next time?

3. The most complex ClickUp automation you have built, in two or three sentences.

4. The hours you can work each weekday, in US Pacific time.

5. Your monthly rate in USD.



HOW WE HIRE



We hire slowly and on purpose.

1. Application. We reply to every complete application within 5 business days.

2. Work sample, about 60 minutes: you review one day of agent outputs and find what is wrong, plus a 3 to 5 minute screen recording of a ClickUp workspace you administer.

3. Video call with a founder.

4. Paid trial for finalists on a sanitized copy of our real operations. You are paid whether or not we hire you.

5. Offer. Both founders review your work first.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote, async-friendly team.

- 10 paid days off a year, after a 90-day probation.

- The major public holidays of the country you work from.

- Performance-based bonuses.

- Direct access to the two founders. Weekly check-ins, fast feedback, no layers.

- Room to grow. Compensation moves with what you can hold.



We are an equal opportunity employer. We d
 on the work you show us.

title: Operations & Project Manager (Fast Growing)
description:
Operations Manager-Execution Partner-Project Killer-Fast-Growing Comic Book Company

Own the operations backbone of a niche comic book brand, work directly with leadership, and get promoted fairly by numbers.



This role is for that special person who wants to become truly exceptional. If that’s you, you already know this message is your signal.



What You Get If You Win Here

- High autonomy: once you’re ramped, you own your queue, schedule, and methods as long as the KPIs are hit. Lots of freedom to figure it out, great for someone that loves building with Legos

- Direct proximity to leadership: you work daily with the Ops Manager on the most important projects in the company.

- Clear advancement path: your growth is tied to visible numbers (tasks shipped, zero-miss cadence, freed founder/ops time, profit/leading metrics), not politics.

- Insane skill growth: the pace and standards here mean every 12 months with us will feel like 3 years of experience in a normal VA/ops role. You can leapfrog your friends. If you join this will change your life. You will work harder than you’ve ever worked before and grow faster than you’ve ever grown before.

- Comic Books!: you’re not just pushing random SaaS tickets; you’re inside a real comic book store seeing rare old comic books, private deals, and the business behind the Hollywood Marvel Movies that everyone loves!

If you’re that person who enjoys working really hard to the point that it takes 2-3 people to do what you did listen up:

Our tasks in asana for projects and ongoing operations are moving at a snail’s pace.

Ops Manager + CEO is chasing tasks, slack policing, cleaning up Asana, and re-explaining context instead of focusing on their jobs.



We’ve had “pleasant” VAs who:

Can’t drive tasks to completion independently

Mark tasks complete with no proof

Miss reports/skip cadence and require chasing.

Drift on ownership, urgency & follow thru

Need hand-holding

I don’t need another task hopper. I need a project killer who comes into ambiguity, creates structure, drives tasks to completion, and actually frees the Ops Manager to focus on his key projects. If this works, his deep work hours and project output go up because you’re handling everything else. We will measure that and tie your promotions/raises to it. This is not for everyone. We’re looking for winners.



What You’ll Actually Do

You will be Ops Manager’s execution partner and force-multiplier. Concrete outputs:

Own Asana: every task has an owner, due date, Done Check, and proof link when completed

Maintain an active queue of 20+ meaningful tasks, prioritized against our key rocks (Marketing, Sales, Ongoing Operations, Cleanup, Admin)

Ship 25+ tasks/week with proof, minimal rework, and zero “ghosted” items

Proactively handle operational issues/fires in designated lanes

Maintain Reporting at Set Cadence, Follow-up loops across projects

Add leverage: plug AI into our workflows (Asana, docs, reports) to make us faster and cleaner without being asked

We do NOT need more SOPS-although you might tighten them on the fly. We need someone to do the operations. If you want to sit and write playbooks all day, this is the wrong seat-that will be an earned responsibility later. If you aren’t ready to work hard daily do not apply.



How We Set You Up To Win (First 90 Days)

We don’t just throw you in the deep end. In your first 30 days, you’ll shadow the Ops Manager, learn our Asana + reporting systems, and get a clear scorecard so you always know what “great” looks like. By 30 days, you’ll own your own project lanes with weekly 1:1s for feedback, support, and removing blockers so you can move faster instead of guessing what we want.



Real Growth Example

One of our Filipino teammates started with us on basic execution work at ~$800/month. Over time, he took ownership of his queue, fixed broken processes, and became the person we trusted to “just handle it.” As his scope grew, so did his comp and stability. Now he makes ~$2,500/month (and we’re working on getting him even more) because he stuck with it and actually grew. A lot of people say they want that, but their resumes show 6–12 month hops. The pattern here is simple: prove you can own outcomes over time, and we grow your responsibilities, trust, and pay accordingly.



Schedule, Hours & Time Zone (No Surprises)

This is a full time, US hours role (roughly US Eastern business hours) with a true 50–60 hour workweek during this growth season. Expect most weeks to be closer to that 60 hour mark. If you want a strict 40 hour cap, this is the wrong seat; if you want a place where extra effort is noticed, measured, and rewarded, you’ll feel at home here. This is not just a job. This is a commitment.



What Winning Looks Like

By Day 30: Ops Manager is spending ~95% of his time on projects, not Slack/Asana/admin fires, because you’re handling those and executing projects alongside him. Profit and leading metrics are moving up faster because of you



By 12 months: You are Ops Manager’s go to operator & on track to become Ops Manager. Nothing important moves in Ops without you knowing. You own the Asana board, key ops projects, and reporting cadence. You’re the person we trust to “just handle it,” and your comp reflects that increased ownership.



If you become that go to operator, you’ll have real say in how we run Ops – you won’t just be ‘executing tickets,’ you’ll help design the system.”



Who This Is NOT For

You prefer to ‘coordinate’ and assign tasks to others instead of doing the work yourself with excellence.

You want to manage people before you’ve truly proven you can personally execute at a high level.

You want a chill, low-pressure 9–5

You need to be told what to do all day and hate being judged by objective numbers

You mark tasks complete without proof or next steps

You change jobs every 6–18 months and blame the company/manager/market/

You get defensive or freeze when given direct feedback or pressure

You are currently juggling multiple full time clients and want to “squeeze us in” on the side.

You are mass applying to dozens of jobs and just want to see who bites first.





Who This IS For

You’ve stayed 2–3+ years in at least one role and can prove outcomes

You like pressure, highly competitive environments, being the one who “gets it done” when others stall

You’ve built systems (trackers, automations, SOPs), not just followed them

You are tech-comfortable: Asana (or similar), CRMs, zaps, AI tools, simple web/ops/marketing stacks

You’re willing to bet on one company instead of juggling lots of smaller, easier gigs.

You hate corporate BS– endless meetings, vague goals, and politics – and would rather be rewarded for what you actually create.

You’re happy to grind 50–60 hours/week no issues. We’re in a BIG growth & push season. It will be like this for the next year and then we’ll see. Everyone wants to grow a lot, but it’s actually happening here.



Comp & Growth

(All of this is written into your contract.)

Months 1–3: Ramp / Trial

• $800/month base, guaranteed, while you learn our systems and we test fit.

• No bonus in this phase. You’re paid to prove you can hit the KPI floors.

Month 4+ – Performance Based Upside

• Base stays at $800 until you’ve hit KPI floors for 2 straight months. After that, base increases to $900/month going forward.

• On top of base, you can earn:

$400 bonus in months where you hit 3 out of 4 KPIs (with Output as one of them).

$1,000 bonus in months where you hit 4 out of 4 KPIs on the weekly scorecard.

• In practice, that means:

Solid performance months ~$1,200–$1,300/month

Killer months (4/4 KPIs)~$1,800–$1,900/month

All bonuses are 100% KPI based (shipped outcomes, taking load off the Ops Manager, zero CEO/manager rescues, tight open loops) and 4/5 culture.



Training & Growth Investment (on top of pay)

We actively invest in making you a sharper teammate. Over time, we’ll put thousands of dollars into your development (courses, coaching, playbooks, and tools) that we choose together based on what will make you more effective in this seat.

We also protect uninterrupted deep work blocks for you every week (no random meetings, no Slack spam). You’re paid to ship outcomes, not sit in back to back Zoom calls.



Important: This is an ON FIELD role. You will not have a team under you to delegate to.

95% of your time is doing the work yourself, 5% is light coordination. If your default mode is to make plans and pass tasks to others, this will be a bad fit.



Compensation here is performance based. Raises are earned through clearly exceeding KPIs and demonstrating core values consistently. If you want “stability” to mean “I can coast and still get raises,” this won’t feel stable. If you want stability to mean “the better I get, the more valuable and secure I become,” you’ll like it here.



How To Apply (24-Hour Test)

Our Hiring Process (So There Are No Surprises)



If your 24 hour answers impress us, the next steps are:

A short interview focused on your past execution.

A live 60 minute work trial inside our real tools where you’ll work directly with the Ops Manager. We do this because talk is cheap. If you don’t like being tested on real work before getting hired, this won’t be a fit.



Do NOT click quick-apply. In the next 24 hours, you must:



Reply with answers to ALL of these (short but specific; bullets are fine):

Q1: Describe the most complex project you personally drove from messy start to completion where you did most of the execution yourself, not just assigning tasks. Include at least one example of how you set your own deadlines and moved forward when other people were slow to respond.”

Q2: Share 3 links or screenshots (Google Docs, Sheets, Asana boards, trackers, automations, etc.) that you built yourself which show how you organize and drive work. Briefly explain each.

Q3: You have 30 tasks due this week and realize you’ll miss 5. Walk me through, step-by-step, how you handle it with your manager and stakeholders.

Q4: Below are 6 messy “tasks” we actually see (all dumped into one list):

– “Fix Asana, it’s a mess”

– “Seller lead texting follow up??”

– “Finance com/projections cadence d2 ”

– “Inventory backlog insane”

– “Need better reporting”

– “Update SOPs

In this role you will NOT have anyone to delegate to assume it’s just you and the Ops Manager.

In a Google Doc, please:



Rewrite these into clear tasks with: Owner (you or Ops Manager), Due Date (next 7–30 days), and a concrete Done Check + proof required. “Write your task descriptions as if you are committing: ‘I will do X by Y time. If Z doesn’t happen by [time], here’s my fallback.’ Generic ‘follow up / request access’ answers will fail you.”

Put them in the order you’d actually do them and explain why in 3–5 bullet points.



Link the Google Doc here (view access).



Spend no more than 30–45 minutes. If you can’t figure this out on your own, this role will be too hard in real life – that’s okay, just skip applying.



Attach your PDF resume/Google Drive link.

As our Virtual Scheduling Coordinator, you will serve as an extension of our front office team, ensuring patients are scheduled appropriately, insurance information is verified accurately, and patient inquiries receive prompt attention.

You will work remotely while supporting the daily operations of our growing dental practice through scheduling, patient communication, and administrative support.

Confirm eligibility and effective dates.

Verify annual maximums and deductibles.

Document all findings accurately in Open Dental.

Alert the team of any benefit concerns or discrepancies.

Maintain accurate patient records in Open Dental.

Document appointment confirmations, insurance information, patient communications, and scheduling notes.

Ensure records remain organized, updated, and easily accessible.

Flag incomplete information and coordinate follow-up when needed.

Online Patient Communication

Monitor website inquiries, online scheduling requests, text messages, and social media inquiries.

Respond promptly with professional, friendly communication.

Convert inquiries into scheduled appointments whenever possible.

Route patient concerns to the appropriate team member when necessary.

Follow up with potential new patients who have not yet scheduled.

Appointment Confirmation & Follow-Up

Confirm upcoming appointments through phone, text, and
 communication.

Reduce last-minute cancellations and no-shows through proactive communication.

Maintain high confirmation rates and schedule retention.

Assist patients with financial questions and direct them to appropriate team members when needed.



Required Qualifications

Prior dental front office, scheduling, treatment coordinator, or administrative experience preferred.

Strong understanding of dental terminology.

Knowledge of dental insurance verification processes.

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.

Experience with Open Dental, Dentrix, Eaglesoft, or similar dental software is preferred.

Reliable internet connection and quiet professional workspace.

HIPAA compliant with a commitment to patient confidentiality.

Self-motivated and capable of working independently.

Success in this role will be measured by:

Accurate insurance verifications completed daily.

High appointment confirmation rates.

Reduced cancellations and no-shows.

Increased scheduling conversion rates from online inquiries.

Clean and updated patient records.

Timely response to patient communications.

Effective schedule management that supports practice production goals.



Why You'll Love Working With Us

Work From Anywhere

Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely while supporting an amazing team.

Flexible Schedule

We value results, accountability, and communication more than micromanagement.

Growth Opportunities

Exceptional team members are rewarded with raises, bonuses, and advancement opportunities.

Positive Team Culture

We're committed to creating an environment built on growth, communication, excellence, and mutual respect.



About Our Practice

We are a thriving dental practice dedicated to delivering exceptional patient care and creating outstanding patient experiences. We believe that systems, communication, and teamwork are the foundation of a successful practice.

We're looking for someone who takes pride in helping patients, enjoys staying organized, and wants to grow with a team that values excellence.

Why you're interested in this position.

A patient who wants an appointment after work hours when the schedule is already full.

We're looking for someone who is dependable, organized, proactive, and excited to grow with us. If that sounds like you, we'd love to meet you!

Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM US Eastern Time

Approximately 9:00 PM–5:00 AM Manila time; you must be able to maintain US Eastern hours when daylight-saving time changes.

Pay: $5–6/hour, depending on experience, paid via Wise.

title: US Tax Preparer (1040/1065/1120-S/1120) - Drake - CPA-Led US Firm - Part-Time, Full-Time in Tax Season
description:
ABOUT US

Prime & Ledger CPAs is a US CPA firm (Arkansas) serving small businesses nationwide - especially restaurants, salons and their owners. The firm is led by a CPA with Big Four and large-corporate tax experience. We prepare individual, partnership, S corporation and C corporation returns, plus FICA tip credit (IRC Section 45B) amended returns.



We work differently from most firms: we built our own tax preparation software ("P&L") that imports last year's return, bulk-imports client data, computes the return, and reconciles it against Drake Tax before filing. You will be trained on it. We want someone who wants to work accurately and efficiently with good tools - not someone who wants to key every number by hand.



SCHEDULE AND PAY

- Part-time (about 4 hours/day) year-round, moving to full-time (8 hours/day) January 15 - April 30 and August 15 - October 15.

- $7 - $10 per hour depending on experience and test results (about $600 - $900/month part-time; $1,200 - $1,800/month full-time in season). Raises for accuracy and turnaround.

- Flexible hours, but you must overlap at least 4 hours daily with US Central Time (e.g., 8:00 AM - 12:00 PM CT = 9:00 PM - 1:00 AM Philippine time).



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Import prior-year returns into our software and verify every extracted line and carryforward (capital loss, passive loss, QBI, Section 179, NOL).

- Organize client documents and bulk-import W-2s, 1099s, K-1s, 1098s, trial balances and payroll data.

- Prepare Forms 1040 (Schedules A, B, C, D/8949, E, SE), 1065, 1120-S and 1120, including K-1s, depreciation (Form 4562) and state returns.

- Reconcile each return in our software to Drake Tax line by line, explain every difference, and clear Drake diagnostics and e-file messages.

NICE TO HAVE

- Philippine CPA, or US EA / CPA candidate.

- Restaurant, salon or hospitality clients; payroll registers; Form 8846 (FICA tip credit).

- Multi-state returns, BBA partnership rules, Form 7203.

- QuickBooks Online or Xero.



SECURITY (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

You will work only inside our secure remote environment. No client data on personal devices, no downloads, no screenshots, no copying files outside our systems. Access is monitored. These rules protect our clients under US federal law (IRC Section 7216).



HOW WE HIRE

1. Apply using the instructions below.

2. Short video call (20 minutes).

title: Microsoft 365, SharePoint, GoHighLevel (GHL) & Automation Developer

# Microsoft 365, SharePoint, GoHighLevel (GHL) & Automation Developer



**Full-Time | Remote (Philippines) | $1,500–$2,000 USD/Month**



### About Our Company



AP Aesthetics is a growing plastic and reconstructive surgery practice based in Southlake, Texas, USA. We operate multiple healthcare service lines and use Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Modernizing Medicine (ModMed), GoHighLevel (GHL), and other business applications.



We are looking for an experienced, resourceful, and highly independent Business Systems & Automation Developer to join our team full-time.



**This is not a general IT help desk position.** We already have an IT company responsible for networking, computers, and infrastructure.



We need someone who can take ownership of our business applications, develop automated workflows, integrate software platforms, troubleshoot technical problems, and continuously improve operational efficiency.



### Primary Responsibilities



**1. Microsoft SharePoint & Microsoft 365**

**3. GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM & Marketing Automation**

- Troubleshoot GHL integrations, workflow errors, duplicate records, and communication issues.

- Collaborate with our marketing team to maintain reliable lead management and follow-up systems.



**4. API Integrations & Software Development**

- Develop integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, OAuth, and related technologies.

- Connect Microsoft 365, GHL, and other approved software platforms.

- Build reliable automated data synchronization processes.

- Implement error handling, logging, and integration monitoring.

- Work directly with software vendors to resolve integration issues.

- Maintain technical documentation for all integrations and workflows.



**5. Electronic Medical Records (EMR) & Healthcare Software**

- Assist with configuration, administration, troubleshooting, and optimization of Modernizing Medicine (ModMed).

- Coordinate with ModMed support and other healthcare software vendors.

- Evaluate and implement supported integrations between the EMR and other business systems.

- Improve clinical and administrative workflows while maintaining appropriate patient privacy and security.

- ModMed experience is preferred but not required.



**6. Business Systems Management & Project Ownership**

- Serve as the primary internal technical resource for our business software applications.

- Independently investigate and resolve software issues.

- Manage technology projects from initial requirements through implementation.

- Document workflows, system configurations, and troubleshooting procedures.

- Collaborate with practice leadership and department managers.

- Recommend improvements to efficiency, productivity, and software utilization.



### Required Qualifications



- Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in business systems development, automation, or software integrations.

- Strong working experience with SharePoint Online, Microsoft Lists, and Power Automate.

- Experience developing solutions with Power Apps.

- Experience with CRM systems, preferably GoHighLevel.

- Proficiency with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, and OAuth authentication.

- Demonstrated ability to integrate third-party applications.

- Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Ability to work independently without constant supervision.

- Strong documentation and project management skills.



### Preferred Qualifications



- Hands-on experience implementing GoHighLevel CRM pipelines, workflows, triggers, and automations.

- Experience with Microsoft Graph API, Azure, PowerShell, Python, SQL, or JavaScript.

- Experience integrating GHL with external systems.

- Experience with healthcare practices, EMR/EHR platforms, or ModMed.

- Experience with marketing automation, lead tracking, and conversion reporting.

- Familiarity with HIPAA, healthcare data security, role-based access controls, and audit logging.



### Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who:

- Takes ownership of projects and completes them independently.

- Can research and learn unfamiliar systems without extensive guidance.

- Understands how technology supports business operations.

- Proactively identifies inefficiencies and recommends improvements.

- Can develop, maintain, and troubleshoot integrations between multiple software platforms.

- Communicates progress clearly and consistently.

- Is dependable, organized, and interested in a long-term position.



### Compensation & Schedule



- **Salary:** $1,500–$2,000 USD/month depending on experience.

- **Employment:** Full-time, 40 hours per week.

- **Location:** Remote, Philippines.

- **Schedule:** Must have substantial working-hour overlap with US Central Time.

- **Position:** Long-term, dedicated role with growth opportunities.



### How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your resume and relevant technical experience.

2. Examples of SharePoint, Microsoft Lists, or Power Automate projects you personally developed.

3. Examples of GoHighLevel CRM implementations or automation workflows you have built.

4. Details of API integrations you have personally developed.

We are seeking a long-term team member who can independently build, manage, troubleshoot, and continuously improve our business technology systems.

title: Senior Bookkeeper & Administrative Assistant
description:
Job Summary



We are looking for an experienced, highly accurate and dependable Senior Bookkeeper & Administrative Assistant to support multiple companies within our group.

Your primary responsibility will be Finance and Bookkeeping, ensuring our financial records are accurate, current and properly reconciled.

As part of a small cross-functional team, you will also support HR administration, compliance, contracts, legal documentation and general company administration when required.

This role requires someone who can take ownership of recurring finance workflows, identify discrepancies independently and ensure issues are resolved without repeated management follow-up.



Key Responsibilities



Finance & Bookkeeping

Maintain accurate day-to-day bookkeeping across multiple companies.

Record and correctly categorize income, expenses, accounts payable and accounts receivable.

Perform bank, payment account and balance reconciliations.

Maintain accurate general ledger records in Xero.

Prepare monthly Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow reports.

Review financial records for missing entries, incorrect classifications and discrepancies.

Maintain supporting documents, invoices, receipts and financial records.

Assist with payroll preparation and employee payment records.

Coordinate financial information required by accountants, auditors, banks and other external parties.

Support inventory and purchase reconciliation with the Supply Chain team.

Maintain and improve bookkeeping SOPs, checklists and recurring finance workflows.

HR, Legal & Administration

Maintain employee records, contracts and HR documentation.

Support onboarding, offboarding and recurring HR administration.

Track important company, contract, insurance, licence and compliance deadlines.

Prepare and organize documents for management, external accountants, lawyers and other professional service providers.

Follow up on outstanding documents, signatures, filings and administrative requirements.

Support other administrative requirements across the company when needed.



What We Expect



Accuracy: Financial information must be checked before it is reported.

Ownership: If something does not reconcile or information is missing, investigate and follow through until it is resolved.

Timeliness: Monthly accounts and recurring finance tasks must stay current.

Early escalation: Raise discrepancies, cash-flow concerns, missing documents or compliance risks early.

Documentation: Records must be organized so another person can understand and verify the work.

Improvement: Identify recurring errors or inefficient processes and recommend practical improvements.



Qualifications & Skills



Minimum 2–3 years of bookkeeping or accounting experience.

Strong hands-on experience with Xero.

Strong understanding of bookkeeping, reconciliations and financial statements.

Excellent attention to detail and numerical accuracy.

Comfortable working with spreadsheets and financial data.

Strong organizational and follow-up skills.

Able to work independently and manage recurring deadlines.

Good written and spoken English.

Comfortable learning new systems and using AI tools for research and administrative work.

Experience with inventory-based businesses is an advantage.

Experience with Dext, Cin7 or similar systems is an advantage.

HR or administrative experience is an advantage but not required.

Accounting or Finance qualifications are preferred, but demonstrated practical bookkeeping capability and accuracy are more important.



How Success Is Measured



Success means the company accounts remain accurate, reconciled and up to date, monthly financial information can be relied upon, outstanding issues are identified early, and management does not need to repeatedly check or chase routine Finance, HR and administrative work.

This role suits someone who is comfortable taking responsibility for accuracy and wants broader exposure beyond bookkeeping within a small company.

title: Bookkeeper and Finance Administration VA
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

Bookkeeper and Finance Administration VA -- ongoing bookkeeping and finance administration support / Part-Time | Remote | 20 hrs/week | Mon-Fri Australian Business Hours

 



ABOUT US

We are a growing remote team looking for a Bookkeeper and Finance Administration VA to join us and take on a dedicated bookkeeping and finance administration role. We work closely with our team members to deliver high-quality support across our operations.

 

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will keep our financial records accurate, organised, and up to date, covering transaction processing, bank reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable, expense tracking, and routine financial reporting. This is a recurring, detail-focused role where you will manage your own tasks independently and flag discrepancies before they become larger issues. This is not a guesswork role. SOPs, process guides, and system access are provided and training will be given. The expectation is straightforward -- do the job well, communicate proactively, and ask when unsure rather than assume. A win in your first 30 days looks like: fully comfortable with our accounting software and recurring finance workflows; bank reconciliations completed accurately and on schedule; payable and receivable registers up to date with overdue invoices flagged and followed up; and your first month-end support completed with a clear status update on outstanding items.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Transaction Processing and Reconciliation

- Record, categorise, and maintain accurate financial transactions, including income, expenses, supplier payments, and customer receipts, in our accounting software

- Reconcile bank accounts and related financial records regularly

- Identify discrepancies, unmatched transactions, and missing documentation for follow-up

- Review records for inconsistencies, duplicate entries, and unusual transactions, escalating issues that need input or professional accounting judgement

- Assist with month-end bookkeeping, including reviewing outstanding transactions and completing scheduled reconciliations

Payables, Receivables, and Expenses

- Record supplier invoices, check supporting documentation, and track payment due dates

- Prepare payment schedules for approval (all payments follow our approval procedures)

- Prepare and issue invoices based on approved information, record payments, and track outstanding balances

- Follow up on overdue invoices

- Categorise business expenses, organise receipts, track reimbursements, and flag transactions that need clarification

Reporting, Records, and Communication

- Generate routine financial reports, such as income and expense summaries, profit and loss reports, and cash flow tracking

- Maintain organised digital financial records and keep payable, receivable, and expense trackers current

- Organise and provide requested records and supporting documents to our accountant or tax professional

- Update supplier and customer records and manage finance-related correspondence

- Provide regular updates on completed tasks, outstanding items, upcoming deadlines, and discrepancies, and suggest improvements to bookkeeping and document management workflows





TOOLS YOU WILL USE

- Accounting and Bookkeeping: Xero, QuickBooks, or similar accounting software, depending on our existing systems

- Invoicing and Expenses: Receipt management, invoicing, and expense tracking tools, where applicable

- Spreadsheets: Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for financial tracking, reconciliations, and reporting

- Productivity: Google Workspace and Spreadsheets

- File Storage: Cloud-based file storage and document management platforms

- Communication:
 and internal communication tools for finance-related coordination

 



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Hands-on bookkeeping or finance administration experience, including transaction processing, bank reconciliations, and accounts payable and receivable

- Working knowledge of accounting software such as Xero, QuickBooks, or a similar platform

- Strong English proficiency, both written and spoken, with clear and professional communication

- Detail-oriented, organised, and reliable, with the ability to manage recurring tasks independently

- Comfortable handling confidential financial information with discretion and integrity

- Proactive communicator -- over-communicates rather than under-communicates

- Knows when to problem-solve independently and when to escalate

- Specific industry experience is not required. Personality, communication quality, and reliability matter most





TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

- High-speed, stable internet connection with backup data in case of power outages or service interruptions

- Mobile phones, tablets, and iPads are not accepted as primary work devices

- Laptop or desktop computer able to run accounting software and spreadsheets smoothly

- A private, secure workspace suitable for handling confidential financial information





WORKING ARRANGEMENT

- Part-time, fully remote

- 20 hours per week

- Mon-Fri, Australian Business Hours (exact schedule to be confirmed upon hire)

- Minimum engagement length: TBC (ongoing role with no fixed end date)

- Scope of responsibilities reviewed periodically, typically every 30 to 90 days

- Strong long-term growth potential for the right person.

Applications without complete screening answers and a voice recording will not be considered.



We are looking for a thoughtful, experienced B2B appointment setter who understands how to build professional relationships and generate genuine interest—not simply maximize call volume.

title: Remote Property Manager – US Rental Portfolio
description:
We are a growing U.S. real estate investment company looking for an experienced Remote Property Manager to manage the day-to-day operations of our single-family rental portfolio.



We currently own 50+ rental properties, many with Section 8 tenants, and plan to acquire dozens of additional properties each year. This person will work directly with the owners and become the lead remote manager as the portfolio grows.

- Handle all tenant communication, rent collection and follow-up

- Manage Section 8/Housing Authority paperwork, inspections, rent increases, HAP payments and tenant certifications

- Coordinate maintenance with our local in-person maintenance team and outside vendors

- Manage work orders from start to completion

- Handle lease renewals, notices, move-ins and move-outs

- Manage vacancies, listings, applicant communication and coordinate showings

- Maintain leases, tenant files, ledgers and property records

- Prepare monthly property-level and portfolio P&Ls

- Track rents, expenses, maintenance, delinquencies and property performance

- Help onboard newly acquired properties

- Build systems and processes as the portfolio grows



We are looking for someone with real U.S. property management experience, ideally including single-family rentals and Section 8.



You must be organized, proactive, excellent at English communication, comfortable dealing directly with tenants, and capable of solving problems without constant supervision.



Experience with property management software, QuickBooks/accounting, Section 8, leasing, maintenance coordination and rent collection is strongly preferred.



This is a full-time, long-term position with significant opportunity to grow into the lead property manager for a large rental portfolio. You will start by fully managing 10 properties but doing P&L for full 50 property portfolio and as you prove yourself, you will manage dozens and dozens more every few months and lead property management for a portfolio with hundreds of tenants. 



To apply, please include:

- Your U.S. property management experience

- Number of units previously managed

- Section 8 experience

- Software you've used

- Expected monthly salary

- A short voice recording introducing yourself

title: Sales Representative
description:
Join a fast-growing US online home goods retailer and enjoy the learning and opportunities that you have while working with us.



We strive to provide 5-star service & shopping assistance to all of our clients, and all of our team is accountable for fulfilling this.



We are looking for a Sales Representative who can assist prospective buyers and close online ecommerce sales.



We're only looking for full-time, long-term, ongoing cooperation.



Work schedules available:

8 AM to 4 PM EST (8 PM to 4 AM MNL)

4 PM to 12 AM EST (4 AM to 12 PM MNL)



Your work week will be 5 days per week, with 2 days off per week. Days off will be selected with your manager. We will try to accommodate your preferences for which days you like, based on availability.



This role starts ASAP.



Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Receive incoming phone calls and live chats from potential customers (prospects) who indicated that they need shopping assistance. This does not include calls and chats from existing customers that need help with their orders (that’s a job for a different department)

Makes follow-up calls, writes follow-up
s, and text messages to potential buyers. We try to follow up 5x with each person that contacted us (unless they indicate that they are no longer interested). We don’t do cold calling. Only reaching out to prospects who interacted with our online store and left their contact information.

After each interaction with a prospect/customer, writes notes & comments in our CRM (Asana)

Communicate efficiently and build rapport with potential customers

Assists prospects in their shopping journey and helps make the purchase decision

Ensures that all prospects’ questions and objections are addressed

Leads every interaction to a close sale, which means an order is placed on our online store

Prepares custom quotes, price matches competitors if necessary, and offers custom discounts. This requires calculating margins & ensuring profitability.

Answering questions about the products we offer, including technical questions. Learns the specifications, features and benefits of our bestsellers. Over time, becomes an expert in the industry.

If not able to answer product-specific questions, conducts research in the materials provided by the supplier, or reaches out to the supplier to get the information

Confirms stock availability and lead times when offering products to prospects

Documents standard procedures and best practices in a written form, so that other tea ---------- mbers can learn from them



Requirements:

At least 2 years of experience in sales on the phone

Experience must include both inbound and outbound sales

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Experience in Customer Service on the phone is a nice to have

Experience in the e-commerce (online shopping) industry is nice to have

Home improvement, construction, and gas plumbing industry experience is a plus

Outgoing, friendly, and lively

Can-do mindset, with a sense of ownership, pride in your performance, and its impact on the company’s success

Long-term commitment - treat this as your career



What we can offer:

Sales commission: 8% of gross profit from all orders closed. Gross profit means the sale amount minus the product and shipping costs. Paid monthly. No upper limit. Monthly commission payouts range between $1,200 (the guaranteed minimum) and as high as $3,000 (for the top performer). The average monthly payout is $1,465 (average from the last 2 years).

$1,200/month minimum guaranteed pay

15 days paid days off per year (also convertible to min. guaranteed commission)

Paid training on all aspects of the role

Opportunities for professional development

Friendly atmosphere

Online Interview process

Fully remote position

title: Full Stack Application Developer
description:
Full Stack Application Developer



Job Overview:



We are seeking a technically strong application developer to enhance our existing recruitment and applicant tracking system built using Bolt.new. You will take ownership of the application’s code, database, integrations, and reliability, improving its functionality as our recruitment operations grow.



This role requires a formal software development education and the ability to independently understand, write, review, and debug application code. Candidates must be able to explain how the system works across the frontend, backend, and database. Experience limited to website design, no-code tools, or AI prompting is insufficient for this position.



Key Responsibilities:



Review the existing application, repository, and database; identify defects, technical debt, security gaps, and opportunities to improve the architecture.



Enhance recruitment workflows, including candidate profiles, job orders, pipeline stages, assessments, interview scheduling, endorsements, follow-ups, and reporting.



Develop and maintain frontend features, backend logic, APIs, and database functionality; translate operational requirements into reliable software.



Work within Bolt.new while independently reviewing and correcting generated code, troubleshooting issues, and implementing changes directly when needed.



Manage Supabase database schemas, SQL queries, migrations, authentication, file storage, server-side functions, and row-level security policies.



Implement role-based access and protect sensitive candidate and client information through appropriate authorization, validation, and secure credential handling.



Use GitHub for version control, branches, pull requests, code reviews, and traceable releases; resolve conflicts and maintain a recoverable change history.



Build and maintain Google product integrations as required, including Calendar, Gmail, Drive, and Sheets; handle OAuth, permissions, tokens, and integration errors.



Improve performance, data accuracy, and usability; investigate failures across the interface, application logic, database, and external integrations.



Test important workflows and permissions before release; manage deployments, monitor errors, and document changes, setup procedures, and technical decisions.



Required Qualifications



 A completed degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Software Development, or a closely related discipline with substantial software development coursework is mandatory.



Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining functional software applications, with hands-on responsibility for both frontend and backend development.



Practical experience with Bolt.new and the ability to understand and maintain the underlying code beyond the platform’s prompting interface.



Strong JavaScript or TypeScript skills and experience with React or a comparable modern application framework; ability to work with the existing application stack.



Hands-on Supabase experience, including PostgreSQL, relational database design, SQL, authentication, row-level security, and server-side functions.



Proficiency with Git and GitHub, including branching, pull requests, merge conflict resolution, and release management.



Experience integrating Google products through APIs and OAuth, including secure handling of credentials and user authorization.



Solid understanding of software architecture, application state, business logic, API design, data validation, debugging, and automated testing.



Ability to safely modify an existing production application while preserving current functionality and data integrity.



Clear communication, strong documentation habits, and the ability to work independently with business stakeholders.







Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

• Vendor & Agency Management: Acting as the main point of contact for agencies and third-party vendors, including managing vendor contacts and leading negotiations.

• Exposure to Walmart or eBay is a plus but not required. 

• Comfort managing integrations, apps, and technical workflows. 

• Proven experience working with agencies, external partners, and managing vendor negotiations.



Education & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, E-commerce, or a related field is preferred. 

• Experience managing or supporting marketplace platforms such as Amazon, Etsy, eBay, etc. 

• Background working in product-based or multi-channel e-commerce businesses. 

• Operational Skills

• Strong understanding of end-to-end e-commerce operations, workflows, and vendor relationship management. 

• Able to manage day-to-day execution and priorities independently. 

• Comfortable working remotely and independently with minimal supervision. 

• Ability to work fully during Central Standard Time (CST) business hours. 

Nice to Have Skills

• Experience with additional third-party marketplace platforms. 

• Familiarity with e-commerce integrations, apps, and third-party tools.

title: Virtual Assistant, Operations & Scheduling
description:
About Bestie



Bestie is a concierge-style pet care company serving Downtown Manhattan. We provide dog walks, drop-ins, daycare, boarding, and house sitting for dogs and cats. Members pay a monthly membership fee and get access to a dedicated concierge team, so they never have to scramble to find someone they trust with their pet. Behind the scenes, a lot of coordination happens. We have 170+ members, 150+ independent contractors who make up our sitter team, and a calendar that changes every day.



The Role



Bestie is growing, and we're adding a second virtual assistant to our operations team. We already have an Executive Assistant who runs our day-to-day operations. You'll work closely with them, take on the behind-the-scenes admin work, and act as their backup so nothing slips through the cracks when things get busy.



At first, your focus will be backend operations: scheduling, booking entry, records, billing checks, responding to
 inquiries, tracking leads, and supporting the Executive Assistant we already have. You won't be handling our concierge phone line at the start. This role suits someone who enjoys owning systems, catches small discrepancies before they become problems, and works well as part of a team.



As you grow into the role, there's also an opportunity to work directly with our members and sitter team and help run our day-to-day concierge line. This isn't the focus at the start, but if you enjoy customer service and relationship management, there's room to grow in that direction as part of a full time role.



Part-Time to Full-Time

The role starts at 20–25 hours per week, with the goal of transitioning to full-time after approximately two months for the right candidate, based on performance and business needs.



Training

You'll get a structured onboarding period during November and December. The training includes:

- Studying our operations handbook

- Shadowing sessions with our current EA

- Handling tasks on your own, then reviewing them together until you're confident



What You'll Do



Scheduling

- Enter each week's confirmed bookings into Time To Pet (a comprehensive, all-in-one pet care management software) and flag any double bookings to the team

- Help schedule recurring and upcoming bookings and keep our sitter availability tracker current





 & lead management

- Respond to new member inquiries by
 and through our website

- Track every lead in our Lead Tracker so no inquiry goes unanswered



Billing, payroll & records

- Help make sure members are charged correctly through Time To Pet

- Double-check invoices before weekly billing runs

- Log bookings in our master Excel tracker



Onboarding

- Members: Set up new member profiles in Time To Pet, create care instruction docs, and update member records

- Sitters: Support the full sitter onboarding process, including profile setup, documentation, availability, and payroll information



What Success Looks Like

- Bookings are entered accurately and on time

- Time To Pet, Google Calendar, and our internal trackers stay in sync

- Double bookings and scheduling conflicts are caught before they become problems

- Member and sitter records are complete and up to date

- Billing discrepancies are identified before invoices are sent

- Every inquiry and lead is tracked and receives a timely response

- You communicate proactively when something is unclear or at risk of being missed



What This Role Is Not

- This is not a personal assistant role.

- You will not be managing the founder's personal schedule or errands.

- You will not be responsible for sales or social media.

- You will not initially be responsible for answering the concierge phone line.



Tools You'll Use

- Google Workspace (Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Gmail), Excel, Time To Pet, WhatsApp, Quo

- Experience with Time To Pet or similar booking software is a plus, but we'll train you on our systems.



Who You Are

- At least 3 years of experience as a virtual assistant, executive assistant, or in an admin or operations role, ideally supporting a US-based or services business

- Highly organized and detail-oriented. You notice when a calendar entry, invoice, and spreadsheet don't match, and you fix it.

- Strong written English. You communicate clearly and warmly with members and teammates.

- A good collaborator who keeps your teammate in the loop and is comfortable sharing ownership of systems

- Able to work independently. You won't always have someone available to answer a question immediately. You should be comfortable assessing a situation, checking our existing processes/documentation, and escalating when a decision is needed

- Proactive. You spot problems before anyone asks and bring solutions along with them.

- Trustworthy with sensitive information, including payroll

- Comfortable with multiple systems and quick to learn new tools

- Available to work hours that overlap with US Eastern Time, including Sundays

- Timely and collaborative in team communication, staying actively engaged and responsive during scheduled working hours

- Flags urgent booking or sitter issues immediately

- Eager to clarify details to ensure high-quality support; Asks questions when information is unclear rather than making assumptions



Nice to have: Experience in pet care, hospitality, or client-facing service businesses, and a genuine love of dogs and cats.



Details

Compensation: $6.00-$7.00/hour

Schedule: 20–25 hours/week, including a required Sunday shift during US Eastern Time. Exact schedule will be established during onboarding based on business needs. 

Start date: Training begins early November
